ignore.reason: the DWD's own citation line for the CatRaRE dataset is quoted verbatim, German title included (*Starkregenereignisse Version 2021.01 mit Überschreitung der DWD-Warnstufe 3 für Unwetter basierend auf RADKLIM-RW Version 2017.002*). The data licence requires this citation to be given as published, and it is what the DOI 10.5676/DWD/CatRaRE_W3_Eta_v2021.01 resolves to; translating it would make the attribution unverifiable (TRANSLATION.md section 3, titles stay German). The surrounding link texts are translated and marked "(in German)".
